notes_for_editor: Brief status (gone), county (Blount), elevation (2,767 ft; 843.4 m is converted from feet) and agency (GSMNP) match the list. No Bunker Hill-specific build date, design, height, staffing or access was found in the sources reached. The thesis PDF returned 403 from the Clemson repository, so only its landing-page abstract is used, and the abstract's statements are park-wide. The UTK item behind the 1951 Roth photo is behind an anti-bot check, so no photo was added; the list's image licences are not known. The 1930 NPS photographs may predate the 1934-1939 build window in the thesis; the sources do not say what they show, so the story does not link them to a tower. Roth and 1930 references are kept as the list's own citations. The story now gives the NRHP date as 'by 1968', as the NRHP text does, and footnotes each sentence that carries a claim.
